result.description:
At City Beach, our people are at the core of what we do, both our customers and our team. All are welcome under the City Beach roof, where value is placed on individual style, teamwork, authenticity, adaptability, and a desire to exceed expectations. 

We stock some of the world's biggest brands across surf, skate, streetwear, and fashion. Our stores are a hub that connect our customers to events, influencers, and trends, allowing them to live life on their terms. 

The role:
As a Software Developer and Database Administrator for City Beach, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, maintaining and supporting applications and database platforms and related data services to ensure data integrity, security, backup, reliability and performance. The role also supports internal reporting and analytics solutions by ensuring data structures, SQL queries, integrations and documentation are accurate, secure and maintainable. This is a full-time position working an average of 38 hours per week based in Brisbane, Queensland.  

Key Responsibilities:
Design, configure, maintain and support database management systems, database architecture, schemas, tables, data structures, data dictionaries and naming conventions to ensure data accuracy and completeness. 
Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain internal software applications and tools. 
Implement, administer and monitor database security, access controls, data integrity controls, backup processes, recovery procedures and disaster recovery planning. 
Perform operational and preventative maintenance for database environments, including scheduled backups, recovery testing, patching, capacity checks and routine health monitoring. 
Write, maintain and optimise SQL queries, stored procedures, views, data extracts, transformations and data models to support reporting, analytics, integrations and operational decision-making. 
Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve database issues, application data issues, performance concerns, failed jobs, data quality exceptions and other incidents affecting business systems whilst encompassing workstations and communication infrastructure.   
Test database systems and upgrades by debugging, tracking, reproducing, logging and resolving issues in accordance with approved testing scripts, procedures and quality processes. 
Prepare and maintain database documentation, including data models, data dictionaries, standards, operational procedures, security guidelines, recovery instructions and system logs. 
Monitor database, application and infrastructure performance to ensure system components operate reliably together, and recommend enhancements to improve availability, scalability, security and performance. 
Develop, maintain and enhance internal reporting solutions and dashboards, including Power BI reports and business performance dashboards, using accurate and governed data sources. 
Collaborate with stakeholders, security vendors, software suppliers and service providers to analyse user, system, database and reporting requirements and deliver practical, secure and maintainable technical solutions. 

About You:
Bachelor’s degree in relevant field or minimum 5 years experience in a similar role
Strong technical knowledge of database administration, database design, data modelling, relational database concepts and data analysis techniques. 
Sound understanding of programming languages such as C#, C++, Python. 
Strong technical knowledge of data models, database design, development, and data analysis techniques 
Proven experience maintaining database environments, including backup and recovery, data integrity controls, performance monitoring, troubleshooting and disaster recovery practices. 
Proficient in writing, maintaining and optimising SQL queries, stored procedures, views, extracts and data transformations. 
Sound understanding of database security principles, access controls, auditability, operational risk and change control processes. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards and data visualisations, including Power BI or similar tools, using accurate and governed data sources. 
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to collect, interpret, and present complex data with accuracy and attention to detail. 

Why Join Us: 
40% team member discount for you, your friends and family to access. 
Access to our Beach Benefits Program where we have partnered with industry leaders to bring our team members discounts on products and memberships to keep you healthy on all fronts. 
Access to Psych Health our Employee Assistance Program. 
Prezzee Gift Cards for major milestones and yearly anniversary celebrations. 
Weekly shared morning tea to celebrate team member milestones. 
Friday 4pm finishes and social drinks every week.? 

Annual income for standard 38 hour week is $85,000 to $95,000 plus superannuation commensurate with industry rate, skills and experience.  

City Beach appreciates the value of a diverse workforce, and we are passionate about actively seeking to accommodate the unique needs of all people. We are committed to building an environment that respects, celebrates, and empowers individual differences. Above all, City Beach aims to ensure everyone is treated with dignity and respect.

Network Engineer | Financial services    Your new company     
 Join a high-performing, technology-driven organisation operating in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment where network infrastructure plays a critical role in business success. With ongoing investment into modern networking and cloud capabilities, the business is continuously evolving its platforms to support growth, performance, and security at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative infrastructure team that works closely with engineering groups and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions. 
   Your new role     
 As a Network Engineer, you'll contribute to the ongoing support and enhancement of a complex network environment spanning LAN, WAN, MAN, cloud, and externally facing systems. Working alongside senior engineers, you'll help maintain a stable, high-performing network while also supporting new initiatives and improvements. 
   
 You'll be involved in implementing monitoring and automation to strengthen operational resilience, as well as supporting secure and scalable connectivity across cloud and on-prem platforms. The role offers a balance of BAU responsibilities and project work, giving you exposure to both day-to-day operations and broader infrastructure uplift initiatives. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Hands-on experience with Cisco and Fortinet technologies across switching, routing, and firewalls (including VDOMs), along with exposure to BGP, VPNs, multicast, and related protocols 
 Experience working in hybrid cloud environments, ideally including AWS (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway) and Azure (ExpressRoute) 
 Background designing and implementing highly available network solutions across multiple connectivity types 
 Exposure to software-defined networking and modern security approaches such as zero trust 
 Around 3-5 years' experience in data networking 
 Exposure to financial services or trading-style environments is beneficial. 
 Familiarity with Linux/Windows servers and tools such as SNMP, Syslog, Datadog, and time synchronisation protocols (NTP/PTP) 
 Experience with network automation and cloud-aligned deployments 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to work in a modern, cloud-first environment with ongoing investment in technology 
 Work from home 2 days per week 
 Exposure to complex, enterprise-scale networking across cloud and on-prem infrastructure 
 A collaborative team culture that values continuous learning and improvement 
 The chance to contribute to meaningful projects while building your technical depth across emerging technologies 
 
  What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to charlie.pym@hays.com.au   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
WELDER (FIRST CLASS) – FULL TIME
Business: DUDIALA ENTERPRISES PTY LTD 
ABN: 67 635 325 192
Trading Name: Universal Metal Fabrication
Location: Unit 2, 42 COLBERT ROAD, CAMPBELLFIELD VIC 3061
Salary: AU$79,500 – AU$85,000 per annum + Superannuation (commensurate with qualifications and experience)
Employment Type: Full-time (minimum 38 hours per week)

Job Published: 18 July 2026 


ABOUT THE BUSINESS
Universal Metal Fabrication is an established Australian metal fabrication business specialising in the design, manufacture, modification, repair, and servicing of custom truck bodies, transport equipment, and fabricated metal components. Operating from Campbellfield, Victoria, the business provides fabrication solutions to commercial transport operators and businesses requiring purpose-built vehicle bodies, structural modifications, repairs, and associated metal fabrication services.
The business undertakes a broad range of fabrication activities including structural steel fabrication, first-class welding, cutting, assembly, fitting, repairs, and the manufacture of custom truck bodies and specialised transport equipment. Operations involve interpreting engineering drawings, fabricating and assembling steel components, performing precision welding, and ensuring completed products meet Australian industry standards, quality requirements, and customer specifications.
Universal Metal Fabrication services clients across the transport, logistics, commercial, and industrial sectors, delivering custom fabrication solutions tailored to individual operational requirements. The business maintains a strong commitment to quality workmanship, workplace safety, operational efficiency, and timely project delivery while continuing to invest in innovation, modern fabrication techniques, and continuous improvement to meet evolving industry requirements.
I would use this version. It reads as a genuine business profile rather than marketing copy, aligns closely with the company's website, and provides a solid factual foundation for a Welder (First Class) (ANZSCO 322313) nomination.

ABOUT THE ROLE
An opportunity exists for an experienced Welder (First Class) (ANZSCO 322313) to join the business on a full-time basis.
This is a hands-on trade position responsible for carrying out a broad range of welding and metal fabrication activities within a workshop and, where required, onsite project environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for interpreting technical drawings, preparing materials, welding fabricated components, inspecting completed work, and supporting the efficient delivery of fabrication projects while maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety.
The position requires the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a fabrication team, maintain production quality, and contribute to the timely completion of engineering and fabrication projects.
This is a permanent full-time position based on a minimum 38-hour working week.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Fabrication Preparation and Material Processing
•	Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions to determine fabrication and welding requirements.
•	Select, inspect, clean, and prepare metal stock and fabricated components for welding.
•	Measure, mark, and cut steel, aluminium, stainless steel, and other metals using hand tools, flame cutting equipment, power tools, and metal cutting machinery.
•	Shape, bend, and prepare metal sections, pipes, and fabricated components using appropriate manual and mechanical techniques.
•	Prepare workpieces to ensure accurate fit-up prior to welding.

Welding and Fabrication
•	Align, position, and secure fabricated components using measuring equipment, clamps, jigs, and hand tools.
•	Perform welding using appropriate processes including MIG, TIG, Arc (MMAW), and other welding techniques where required.
•	Join metal components through welding, bolting, riveting, and related fabrication methods.
•	Manufacture, assemble, modify, and repair fabricated metal products in accordance with engineering specifications.
•	Complete fabrication work while maintaining dimensional accuracy, structural integrity, and quality standards.

Quality Assurance and Finishing
•	Inspect completed welds for penetration, bead profile, alignment, strength, and finish quality.
•	Identify and rectify welding defects or fabrication inconsistencies where required.
•	Finish fabricated products through grinding, filing, polishing, cleaning, and other finishing techniques.
•	Ensure completed work complies with project specifications, engineering drawings, and quality requirements.
•	Maintain accurate measurements and workmanship throughout all fabrication activities.

Workshop Operations and Equipment
•	Operate welding equipment, grinders, cutting machinery, lifting equipment, and fabrication tools safely and efficiently.
•	Perform routine maintenance and basic servicing of welding equipment and workshop tools.
•	Maintain clean, organised, and safe work areas throughout fabrication activities.
•	Assist with material handling, storage, and workshop housekeeping.
•	Support efficient workflow to meet production schedules and project deadlines.

Workplace Safety and Compliance
•	Comply with Workplace Health and Safety requirements and safe work procedures at all times.
•	Correctly use personal protective equipment (PPE) and welding safety equipment.
•	Maintain awareness of welding hazards, confined spaces, hot works, and safe handling of materials.
•	Report hazards, equipment faults, and safety concerns promptly.
•	Contribute to maintaining a safe, professional, and compliant workshop environment.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
•	Relevant trade qualification in Engineering Fabrication Trade, Fabrication, Welding, Metal Fabrication, or a closely related discipline, together with at least one (1) year of relevant full-time post-qualification experience; or equivalent skills and experience suitable for the position.
•	Demonstrated experience undertaking welding and metal fabrication activities within an engineering, manufacturing, construction, or fabrication environment.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and fabrication specifications.
•	Demonstrated competency using MIG, TIG, Arc (MMAW), or comparable welding processes.
•	Sound understanding of fabrication techniques, welding quality standards, and workshop safety procedures.
•	Ability to work effectively within production schedules while maintaining quality workmanship and attention to detail.

KEY COMPETENCIES
•	Welding and metal fabrication.
•	Interpretation of engineering drawings and technical specifications.
•	Material preparation and fabrication techniques.
•	MIG, TIG and Arc welding capability.
•	Quality control and weld inspection.
•	Workshop operations and equipment handling.
•	Time management and production workflow.
•	Problem-solving and technical judgement.
•	Workplace Health and Safety compliance.
•	Communication, teamwork, and commitment to continuous improvement.

HOW TO APPLY
Please submit a one-page CV outlining your relevant qualifications, experience, and availability.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
